jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

This position is located within our Discovery Research Unit focused on Cancer Cell Dependencies (CCD) within the Oncology Discovery organization dedicated to the discovery and development of novel cancer therapeutics. We collaborate closely with functions in Therapeutic Modalities, Pharmaceutical Science as well as within the oncology therapeutic area to translate hypotheses into innovative therapeutics.

The Opportunity

As a Senior / Principal Scientist Discovery Oncology, you will work within a collaborative team of motivated and scientifically rigorous scientists and associates to conduct preclinical research and advance our clinical and preclinical drug programs in the field of cancer cell biology. You will translate basic research findings into therapeutic strategies, utilizing genetic and pharmacological approaches to understand target mechanisms of action, generate patient stratification strategies and identify rational drug combinations that can be translated into the clinic.

• Lead internal target identification initiatives and exploratory activities, from initial ideation to nomination of the program and proactively seek out future horizon opportunities and be passionate about the co-creation of new areas of focus.

• Lead internal and external global cross-functional portfolio projects of high strategic impact, show resource awareness, coordinate cross-functional efforts to meet long-term project objectives as a matrix leader.

• Design, execute and analyze/interpret experimental strategies and present research results and methodologies at regular meetings with teams, key stakeholders and/or interact regularly with project leaders, project teams and other research forums. Work collaboratively with scientists and associates across oncology discovery research units to integrate complex data sets including high dimensional ‘omic’ data in pre-clinical settings for target validation and increased understanding of target biology and MoA of therapeutic compounds.

• Drive resolution of key scientific challenges in their respective area of expertise and provide feedback to scientific communities. Proactively seek out and share new knowledge and incorporate this into individual project(s) as well as the overall portfolio, catalyze knowledge sharing within pRED function and make knowledge accessible throughout pRED.

• External Innovation (EI) SPOC for Discovery: Lead biology/discovery evaluations across Triage, Non-Confidential, Pre-DD, and DD stages for assets from Discovery through DevGo (handing over to EDO post-DevGo). Deliver clear Go/No-Go recommendations. Identify critical scientific questions for DD in preDD setting, co-author Pre-DD and DD-request slide decks, and present at governance check-ins. Lead biology DD activities, directly oversee Material Transfer Agreement (MTA) studies and data reporting, and contribute to final DD reports and governance presentations.

• Role model curiosity for working flexibly in new concepts and a matrix environment, take a proactive role in personal growth and scientific development. Enable individual and organizational learning within their teams and across the Discovery organization in order to advance the portfolio and scientific innovation. Thrive in a dynamic, inclusive environment and contribute to building a culture that embraces scientific excellence, accountability, urgency, partnerships with key stakeholders, continuous learning and improvement, increasing technical skill base and cancer biology expertise.

• Provide clarity of vision, coaching and architecture to enable smart decision-making, prioritization and the highest level of performance. Incentivize people to constructively challenge the status quo and stop doing work that does not have scientific and business impact.

• Role model E2E collaboration. Hold team members accountable for sharing, data, systems and methods. Nurture a culture where we debate, decide and commit, while respecting colleagues' intent and expertise regardless of hierarchy.

• Hold themselves, colleagues and teams accountable for delivery and resource management. Incentivize and reward based on impact. Apply proactive performance management: ensure consequences for failure to deliver or engage in the foundational behaviors and mindset required for success.

Who you are

• PhD or MD/PhD in Molecular or Cellular Biology, Immunology, Pharmacology (or a comparable biological science) with 6+ years of relevant postdoctoral experience in an academic or pharmaceutical/biotech environment.

• Prior industry experience is preferred.

• Experience in cancer drug discovery /translational research and targeting molecular pathways using diverse modalities including large and/or small molecule compounds.

• Experience in intracellular oncogenic signalling and cancer cell dependencies is required. Extensive knowledge and understanding of other areas of cancer biology including but not limited to cell cycle regulation, transcription factors, oncogenic signalling and or ADC biology is a plus.

• Experience supporting IND study reports or contributing to relevant sections of IND study reports is an advantage.

• Collaborative mind-set, capable and eager to work within a matrix organization, collective goal achievement, ability to work in a team environment, good communication skills.

Unwavering focus, collaborative teamwork and exceptional delivery are key behaviors that drive our mission of doing now what patients need next. Together, we can be transformative.

If you are passionate about contributing to a committed team and have the dedication to partnership and innovation, Roche is the place for you! Every role at Roche plays a part in making a difference in patients’ lives. Apply now and join us in making an impact.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Ecco cosa ci rende Roche.

Questa posizione si trova all'interno della nostra Discovery Research Unit focalizzata sulle dipendenze delle cellule tumorali (CCD) all'interno dell'organizzazione Oncology Discovery dedicata alla scoperta e allo sviluppo di nuovi tumori terapeutici. Collaboriamo a stretto contatto con le funzioni nelle modalità terapeutiche, nella scienza farmaceutica e nell'area terapeutica oncologica per tradurre ipotesi in terapeutici innovativi.

L'opportunità

Come Senior / Principal Scientist Discovery Oncology, lavorerai all'interno di un team collaborativo di scienziati e collaboratori motivati e scientificamente rigorosi per condurre una ricerca preclinica e far progredire i nostri programmi clinici e preclinici nel campo della biologia delle cellule tumorali. Tradurrete i risultati di ricerca di base nelle strategie terapeutiche, utilizzando approcci genetici e farmacologici per comprendere i meccanismi di azione, generare strategie di stratificazione dei pazienti e identificare le combinazioni di droga razionali che possono essere tradotte nella clinica.

• Guidare le iniziative di identificazione degli obiettivi interni e le attività esplorative, dall'ideazione iniziale alla nomina del programma e cercare proattivamente le opportunità future dell'orizzonte e essere appassionati della co-creazione di nuove aree di fuoco.

• Condurre progetti di portafoglio interfunzionali interni ed esterni di alto impatto strategico, mostrare la consapevolezza delle risorse, coordinare gli sforzi interfunzionali per raggiungere obiettivi di progetto a lungo termine come leader di matrice.

• Progettare, eseguire e analizzare/interpretare strategie sperimentali e presentare risultati di ricerca e metodologie in incontri regolari con team, stakeholder chiave e/o interagire regolarmente con i leader del progetto, team di progetto e altri forum di ricerca. Lavorare in collaborazione con gli scienziati e gli associati delle unità di ricerca per la scoperta di oncologia per integrare i set di dati complessi, compresi i dati “omici” dimensionali elevati in contesti preclinici per la validazione del bersaglio e una maggiore comprensione della biologia target e della MoA dei composti terapeutici.

• Promuovere la risoluzione delle principali sfide scientifiche nella loro rispettiva area di competenza e fornire feedback alle comunità scientifiche. Proattivamente cercare e condividere nuove conoscenze e incorporare questo in singoli progetti, così come il portafoglio generale, catalizzare la condivisione della conoscenza all'interno della funzione pRED e rendere la conoscenza accessibile durante il pRED.

• SPOC per la scoperta dell'innovazione esterna (EI): Produrre valutazioni di biologia/scoperta attraverso le fasi di Triage, Non-Confidential, Pre-DD e DD per le attività da Discovery attraverso DevGo (consegnare a EDO post-DevGo). Fornire chiare raccomandazioni Go / No-Go. Identificare domande scientifiche critiche per DD in impostazione preDD, co-autore Pre-DD e DD-richiesta ponti, e presenti ai controlli di governance. Dirigere le attività di DD di biologia, supervisionare direttamente gli studi e la reportistica dei dati del Material Transfer Agreement (MTA) e contribuire a relazioni DD finali e presentazioni di governance.

• La curiosità del modello Role per lavorare in modo flessibile in nuovi concetti e in un ambiente matrice, assume un ruolo proattivo nella crescita personale e nello sviluppo scientifico. Abilitare l'apprendimento individuale e organizzativo all'interno dei propri team e in tutta l'organizzazione Discovery al fine di promuovere il portafoglio e l'innovazione scientifica. Promuovere in un ambiente dinamico e inclusivo e contribuire a costruire una cultura che abbraccia l'eccellenza scientifica, la responsabilità, l'urgenza, le partnership con le principali parti interessate, l'apprendimento continuo e il miglioramento, aumentando la base di competenze tecniche e l'esperienza di biologia del cancro.

• Fornire chiarezza di visione, coaching e architettura per consentire il processo decisionale intelligente, la priorità e il massimo livello di prestazioni. Incentivizzare le persone a sfidare costruttivamente lo status quo e smettere di fare lavoro che non ha impatto scientifico e commerciale.

• Role model E2E collaborazione. Tenere i membri del team responsabili per la condivisione, i dati, i sistemi e i metodi. Nurtura una cultura in cui dibattiamo, decidiamo e impegniamo, nel rispetto dell'intento e dell'esperienza dei colleghi indipendentemente dalla gerarchia.

• Tenere se stessi, colleghi e team responsabili per la consegna e la gestione delle risorse. Incentivizzare e premiare in base all'impatto. Applicare la gestione delle prestazioni proattive: assicurarsi che le conseguenze per il mancato rilascio o l'impegno nei comportamenti fondamentali e nella mentalità necessaria per il successo.

Chi sei

• PhD o MD/PhD in Biologia Molecolare o Cellulare, Immunologia, Farmacologia (o una scienza biologica comparabile) con 6+ anni di esperienza postdoctorale rilevante in un ambiente accademico o farmaceutico/biotecnico.

• L'esperienza del settore prioritario è preferita.

• Esperienza nella scoperta di farmaci per il cancro / ricerca traduttiva e la destinazione di percorsi molecolari utilizzando diverse modalità tra cui grandi e / o piccoli composti molecolari.

• L'esperienza nella segnalazione oncogena intracellulare e le dipendenze delle cellule tumorali è necessaria. Conoscenza estesa e comprensione di altre aree di biologia del cancro, tra cui ma non limitata alla regolazione del ciclo cellulare, fattori di trascrizione, segnalazione oncogenica e o biologia ADC è un plus.

• L'esperienza che sostiene i rapporti di studio IND o che contribuisce a sezioni rilevanti dei rapporti di studio IND è un vantaggio.

• Insieme mentale collaborativo, capace e desideroso di lavorare all'interno di un'organizzazione matrice, raggiungimento obiettivo collettivo, capacità di lavorare in un ambiente di squadra, buone capacità di comunicazione.

Unwavering focus, lavoro di squadra collaborativo e consegna eccezionale sono i comportamenti chiave che guidano la nostra missione di fare ora ciò che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. Insieme, possiamo essere trasformativi.

Se siete appassionati di contribuire a un team impegnato e avere la dedizione alla partnership e all'innovazione, Roche è il posto per voi! Ogni ruolo di Roche gioca una parte nel fare la differenza nella vita dei pazienti. Applicare ora e unirsi a noi nel fare un impatto.

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un Equal Opportunity Employer.

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Eine gesündere Zukunft. Es ist das, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche.

Diese Position befindet sich in unserer Discovery Research Unit mit Schwerpunkt auf Krebszellenabhängigkeiten (CCD) innerhalb der Oncology Discovery Organisation, die sich der Entdeckung und Entwicklung neuartiger Krebstherapeutika widmet. Wir arbeiten eng mit Funktionen in den Bereichen Therapeutische Modalitäten, Pharmazeutische Wissenschaft sowie im onkologischen Therapiebereich zusammen, um Hypothesen in innovative Therapeutika umzusetzen.

Die Chance

Als Senior / Principal Scientist Discovery Oncology arbeiten Sie in einem Team von motivierten und wissenschaftlich strengen Wissenschaftlern und Mitarbeitern, um präklinische Forschung durchzuführen und unsere klinischen und präklinischen Arzneimittelprogramme auf dem Gebiet der Krebszellbiologie voranzutreiben. Sie werden Grundlagenforschungsergebnisse in therapeutische Strategien übersetzen, genetische und pharmakologische Ansätze nutzen, um Zielwirkungsmechanismen zu verstehen, Patientenschichtungsstrategien zu generieren und rationale Arzneimittelkombinationen zu identifizieren, die in die Klinik übersetzt werden können.

• Führen Sie interne Initiativen zur Zielidentifizierung und Sondierungsaktivitäten, von der ersten Idee bis zur Nominierung des Programms, suchen Sie proaktiv nach zukünftigen Horizontmöglichkeiten und setzen Sie sich für die gemeinsame Schaffung neuer Schwerpunkte ein.

• Führen Sie interne und externe globale funktionsübergreifende Portfolioprojekte mit hoher strategischer Wirkung, zeigen Sie Ressourcenbewusstsein und koordinieren Sie funktionsübergreifende Bemühungen, um als Matrixführer langfristige Projektziele zu erreichen.

• Entwerfen, Ausführen und Analysieren/Interpretieren von experimentellen Strategien und Präsentieren von Forschungsergebnissen und Methoden in regelmäßigen Treffen mit Teams, wichtigen Stakeholdern und/oder regelmäßige Interaktion mit Projektleitern, Projektteams und anderen Forschungsforen. Arbeiten Sie in Zusammenarbeit mit Wissenschaftlern und Mitarbeitern in onkologischen Forschungseinheiten, um komplexe Datensätze einschließlich hochdimensionaler "omischer" Daten in präklinischen Umgebungen für die Zielvalidierung und ein besseres Verständnis der Zielbiologie und des MoA von therapeutischen Verbindungen zu integrieren.

• Förderung der Lösung wichtiger wissenschaftlicher Herausforderungen in ihrem jeweiligen Fachgebiet und Bereitstellung von Feedback für wissenschaftliche Gemeinschaften. Proaktiv neues Wissen suchen und teilen und es in einzelne Projekte sowie das gesamte Portfolio integrieren, den Wissensaustausch innerhalb der pRED-Funktion katalysieren und Wissen im gesamten pRED zugänglich machen.

• Externe Innovation (EI) SPOC for Discovery: Führen Sie Biologie-/Entdeckungsbewertungen in Triage-, Nicht-Vertraulichen-, Pre-DD- und DD-Phasen für Assets von Discovery bis DevGo (Übergabe an EDO post-DevGo). Geben Sie klare Go / No-Go-Empfehlungen. Identifizieren Sie kritische wissenschaftliche Fragen für DD in preDD Einstellung, Co-Autor Pre-DD und DD-Anfrage Diadecks, und bei Governance Check-ins anwesend. Führen Sie biologische DD-Aktivitäten, überwachen Sie direkt Material Transfer Agreement (MTA) -Studien und Datenberichte und tragen Sie zu endgültigen DD-Berichten und Governance-Präsentationen bei.

• Rolle Modell Neugier für die Arbeit flexibel in neuen Konzepten und einer Matrix-Umgebung, nehmen eine proaktive Rolle in persönliches Wachstum und wissenschaftliche Entwicklung. Ermöglichen Sie individuelles und organisatorisches Lernen innerhalb ihrer Teams und innerhalb der Discovery-Organisation, um das Portfolio und die wissenschaftliche Innovation voranzutreiben. Gedeihen Sie in einem dynamischen, integrativen Umfeld und tragen Sie zum Aufbau einer Kultur bei, die wissenschaftliche Exzellenz, Rechenschaftspflicht, Dringlichkeit, Partnerschaften mit wichtigen Interessengruppen, kontinuierliches Lernen und Verbesserung, zunehmende technische Fähigkeiten und Fachwissen in der Krebsbiologie umfasst.

• Schaffen Sie Klarheit über Vision, Coaching und Architektur, um intelligente Entscheidungsfindung, Priorisierung und höchste Leistung zu ermöglichen. Anreize für Menschen, den Status quo konstruktiv in Frage zu stellen und keine Arbeit mehr zu tun, die keine wissenschaftlichen und geschäftlichen Auswirkungen hat.

• Rollenmodell E2E Zusammenarbeit. Halten Sie die Teammitglieder für die gemeinsame Nutzung, Daten, Systeme und Methoden verantwortlich. Pflegen Sie eine Kultur, in der wir diskutieren, entscheiden und verpflichten, während Sie die Absicht und das Fachwissen der Kollegen unabhängig von der Hierarchie respektieren.

• Halten Sie sich, Kollegen und Teams für die Bereitstellung und das Ressourcenmanagement verantwortlich. Anreize und Belohnungen basierend auf Auswirkungen. Proaktives Leistungsmanagement anwenden: Sorgen Sie für Konsequenzen, wenn Sie die grundlegenden Verhaltensweisen und Denkweisen, die für den Erfolg erforderlich sind, nicht liefern oder sich nicht daran beteiligen.

Wer du bist

• PhD oder MD / PhD in Molekular- oder Zellbiologie, Immunologie, Pharmakologie (oder einer vergleichbaren biologischen Wissenschaft) mit 6+ Jahren einschlägiger Postdoc-Erfahrung in einem akademischen oder pharmazeutischen / Biotech-Umfeld.

• Vorherige Branchenerfahrung wird bevorzugt.

• Erfahrung in der Entdeckung von Krebsmedikamenten / translationalen Forschung und Targeting molekularer Wege unter Verwendung verschiedener Modalitäten, einschließlich großer und / oder kleiner Molekülverbindungen.

• Erfahrung mit intrazellulären onkogenen Signalwegen und Abhängigkeiten von Krebszellen ist erforderlich. Umfangreiches Wissen und Verständnis anderer Bereiche der Krebsbiologie, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf Zellzyklusregulation, Transkriptionsfaktoren, onkogene Signalisierung und oder ADC-Biologie, ist ein Plus.

• Die Erfahrung, IND-Studienberichte zu unterstützen oder zu relevanten Abschnitten von IND-Studienberichten beizutragen, ist von Vorteil.

• Kollaborative Denkweise, fähig und eifrig, innerhalb einer Matrixorganisation zu arbeiten, kollektive Zielerreichung, Fähigkeit, in einer Teamumgebung zu arbeiten, gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

Unerschütterliche Konzentration, kollaborative Teamarbeit und außergewöhnliche Lieferung sind wichtige Verhaltensweisen, die unsere Mission vorantreiben, jetzt das zu tun, was Patienten als nächstes brauchen. Gemeinsam können wir transformieren.

Wenn Sie leidenschaftlich zu einem engagierten Team beitragen und sich für Partnerschaft und Innovation engagieren, ist Roche der richtige Ort für Sie! Jede Rolle bei Roche trägt dazu bei, das Leben der Patienten zu verändern. Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und machen Sie mit uns gemeinsam etwas.

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche.

Ce poste est situé au sein de notre Unité de recherche Découverte axée sur les dépendances des cellules cancéreuses (CCD) au sein de l'organisation Oncology Discovery dédiée à la découverte et au développement de nouveaux traitements contre le cancer. Nous collaborons étroitement avec les fonctions en Modalités Thérapeutiques, en Science Pharmaceutique ainsi qu'au sein du domaine thérapeutique oncologique pour traduire les hypothèses en thérapies innovantes.

L'opportunité

En tant que chercheur principal ou principal Découverte Oncologie, vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe de scientifiques et d'associés motivés et scientifiquement rigoureux pour mener des recherches précliniques et faire progresser nos programmes cliniques et précliniques de médicaments dans le domaine de la biologie cellulaire cancéreuse. Vous allez traduire les résultats de la recherche fondamentale en stratégies thérapeutiques, en utilisant des approches génétiques et pharmacologiques pour comprendre les mécanismes d'action cibles, générer des stratégies de stratification des patients et identifier des combinaisons de médicaments rationnelles qui peuvent être traduites dans la clinique.

• Diriger les initiatives internes d'identification des cibles et les activités exploratoires, depuis l'idée initiale jusqu'à la nomination du programme et chercher proactivement des possibilités d'avenir et être passionné par la co-création de nouveaux domaines d'intérêt.

• Diriger les projets de portefeuille interfonctionnels internes et externes à fort impact stratégique, faire preuve de sensibilisation aux ressources, coordonner les efforts interfonctionnels pour atteindre les objectifs à long terme du projet en tant que chef de file matriciel.

• Concevoir, exécuter et analyser des stratégies expérimentales et présenter des résultats de recherche et des méthodologies lors de réunions régulières avec des équipes, des intervenants clés et/ou interagir régulièrement avec des chefs de projet, des équipes de projet et d'autres forums de recherche. Collaborer avec des scientifiques et des associés de toutes les unités de recherche sur les découvertes en oncologie pour intégrer des ensembles de données complexes, y compris des données omiques à haute dimension dans des contextes précliniques pour la validation des cibles et une meilleure compréhension de la biologie cible et du MoA des composés thérapeutiques.

• Favoriser la résolution des principaux défis scientifiques dans leur domaine d'expertise respectif et fournir une rétroaction aux communautés scientifiques. Rechercher et partager proactivement de nouvelles connaissances et les intégrer dans les projets individuels ainsi que dans l'ensemble du portefeuille, catalyser le partage des connaissances au sein de la fonction pRED et rendre les connaissances accessibles tout au long de la fonction pRED.

• Innovation externe (EI) SPOC pour la découverte : Évaluations de la biologie et de la découverte des principaux stades du triage, de la non-confidentielle, de la pré-DD et de la DD pour les actifs de Discovery à DevGo (transfert vers EDO post-DevGo). Fournir des recommandations claires pour aller/ne pas aller. Identifier les questions scientifiques critiques pour le DD dans le cadre de la pré-DD, co-auteurs de diaporamas pré-DD et DD-request et présents aux vérifications de gouvernance. Les activités de DD en biologie principale, qui supervisent directement les études et les rapports sur les données de l'Accord de transfert de matériel, et qui contribuent aux rapports finaux de DD et aux présentations sur la gouvernance.

• La curiosité de modèle de rôle pour travailler avec souplesse dans de nouveaux concepts et un environnement matriciel, jouent un rôle proactif dans la croissance personnelle et le développement scientifique. Permettre l'apprentissage individuel et organisationnel au sein de leurs équipes et dans l'ensemble de l'organisation Discovery afin de faire progresser le portefeuille et l'innovation scientifique. Dans un environnement dynamique et inclusif, et contribuer à l'édification d'une culture qui englobe l'excellence scientifique, la responsabilisation, l'urgence, les partenariats avec les intervenants clés, l'apprentissage et l'amélioration continus, l'accroissement des compétences techniques et l'expertise en biologie du cancer.

• Fournir une clarté de vision, de coaching et d'architecture pour permettre une prise de décision intelligente, l'établissement de priorités et le plus haut niveau de performance. Inciter les gens à contester de façon constructive le statu quo et à cesser de faire du travail qui n'a pas d'impact scientifique et commercial.

• Modèle de rôle Collaboration E2E. Tenir les membres de l'équipe responsables du partage, des données, des systèmes et des méthodes. Nurturez une culture où nous débattons, décidons et nous engageons, tout en respectant l'intention et l'expertise de nos collègues, indépendamment de la hiérarchie.

• Tenez-vous, collègues et équipes responsables de la prestation et de la gestion des ressources. Inciter et récompenser en fonction de l'impact. Appliquer une gestion proactive du rendement : assurer les conséquences de l'échec à livrer ou à s'engager dans les comportements fondamentaux et l'état d'esprit requis pour réussir.

Qui vous êtes

• PhD ou MD/PhD en biologie moléculaire ou cellulaire, immunologie, pharmacologie (ou une science biologique comparable) avec 6 ans et plus d'expérience postdoctorale pertinente dans un environnement universitaire ou pharmaceutique/biotech.

• L'expérience antérieure de l'industrie est privilégiée.

• Expérience de la découverte de médicaments contre le cancer et de la recherche translationnelle et ciblage des voies moléculaires à l'aide de diverses modalités, y compris les composés de grandes et/ou de petites molécules.

• L'expérience de la signalisation oncogène intracellulaire et de la dépendance des cellules cancéreuses est requise. La connaissance et la compréhension approfondies d'autres domaines de la biologie du cancer, y compris, sans s'y limiter, la régulation du cycle cellulaire, les facteurs de transcription, la signalisation oncogène et la biologie ADC sont un atout.

• L'expérience qui appuie les rapports d'études de l'IND ou qui contribue à des sections pertinentes des rapports d'études de l'IND est un avantage.

• Un état d'esprit collaboratif, capable et désireux de travailler au sein d'une organisation matricielle, la réalisation d'objectifs collectifs, la capacité de travailler en équipe, de bonnes compétences en communication.

Une concentration inébranlable, un travail d'équipe collaboratif et une prestation exceptionnelle sont des comportements clés qui motivent notre mission de faire maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. Ensemble, nous pouvons être transformateurs.

Si vous êtes passionné de contribuer à une équipe engagée et avez le dévouement pour le partenariat et l'innovation, Roche est l'endroit pour vous! Chaque rôle de Roche joue un rôle dans la vie des patients. Postulez maintenant et rejoignez-nous pour faire un impact.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Kaiseraugst ist ein Eckpfeiler im weltweiten Produktions- und Logistiknetz von Roche. Über 1900 Personen sind hier beschäftigt. Der Standort beherbergt den größten und innovativsten Verpackungsbetrieb von Roche weltweit. Durch eigenverantwortliche Zusammenarbeit in divers aufgestellten Teams verfolgen wir unsere Vision: Die bestmögliche Patientenversorgung bei geringen Kosten für die Gesellschaft!

In der Manufacturing Unit Solids DP kümmern wir uns an den Produktionsstandorten in Kaiseraugst und Basel um die Herstellung und Verpackung verschiedener fester Arzneiformen. Hierzu zählen Filmtabletten, Kapseln und Granulate zur Herstellung von Oralsuspensionen.

Die Möglichkeit

Wir bieten in der Manufacturing Unit Solids DP ein Praktikum in der Technical Asset Care Gruppe (Werkstatt) an, welches sich primär an Studierende aus dem Bereich Pharmatechnik, Maschinenbau, Life Sciences oder Ingenieurswesen richtet. Während des Praktikums unterstützt du die Technical Unit im Produktionsbetrieb Kaiseraugst. Du erlernst hierbei den Umgang und die Umsetzung der umfangreichen GMP-Regularien der pharmazeutischen Industrie.

In dieser Position wirst du:

• Selbstständig kleinere Projekte bearbeiten (technische und verfahrenstechnische Fragestellungen).

• Notwendige Betriebsvorschriften und Arbeitsanweisungen (Standard Operating Procedure) im Bereich Instandhaltung, Störungsbehebung erstellen und überarbeiten.

• Die Optimierung unterschiedlicher Prozesse unterstützen.

• Arbeiten mit SAP hinsichtlich Neuanlegen, Anpassen und Löschen von Wartungsplänen und Task Listen tätigen.

• Fragestellungen zur Instandhaltung verschiedener Anlagen klären.

• Das Team bei Changes und Massnahmen (Corrective Actions) sowie bei Routinetätigkeiten unterstützen.

• Kontaktperson für verschiedene Schnittstellen und Ansprechpartner sein.

Wer Du Bist

Folgende Kompetenzen runden dein Profil ab:

• Du bist aktuell an einer Universität oder Fachhochschule immatrikuliert, oder du hast innerhalb von 12 Monaten vor Praktikumsbeginn deinen Abschluss gemacht, im Feld der Pharmatechnik, Maschinenbau, Life Sciences, Ingenieurwesen, Pharmamanagement & Produktion oder verwandten Richtungen.

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

• Ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative und selbstständiger Arbeitsweise sowie schnelles Auffassungsvermögen.

• Interesse an der konstruktiven Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Stakeholdern sowie an der Arbeit in einem dynamischen Team.

• Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Präsentationsskills.

• Gute IT-Kenntnisse in Office Applikationen.

Zusätzliche Information

• Die Dauer des Praktikums liegt bei 6 - 12 Monaten und findet am Standort Kaiseraugst statt.

• Bitte gib in deinem Motivationsschreiben eindeutig das gewünschte Anfangsdatum und die Dauer des Praktikums an. Bewerbungen müssen einen Lebenslauf und ein Motivationsschreiben enthalten, die beide in einem Dokument zusammengefasst sind, sowie eine aktuelle Leistungsübersicht.

• Bitte gib in deinem Motivationsschreiben oder Lebenslauf eindeutig an, an welchem Datum du die Universität abgeschlossen hast, falls das schon geschehen ist.

• Aufgrund von Regulierungen müssen Bürger außerhalb der EU/EFTA mit einem Dokument ihrer Universität nachweisen, dass es sich um ein Pflichtpraktikum handelt, dessen genaue Länge angeben, sowie eine Immatrikulationsbescheinigung vorlegen.

• Dieses Praktikum ist nicht für eine Bachelor- oder Masterarbeit geeignet.

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören. Bewirb dich jetzt, um diese spannende Möglichkeit zu entdecken!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Roche Kaiseraugst è una pietra angolare della rete globale di produzione e logistica di Roche. Oltre 1900 persone sono impiegate qui. Il sito ospita le più grandi e innovative operazioni di imballaggio di Roche in tutto il mondo. Attraverso la cooperazione indipendente in diverse squadre, perseguiamo la nostra visione: la migliore assistenza possibile ai pazienti a basso costo per la società!

Nell'unità di produzione Solids DP ci occupiamo della produzione e dell'imballaggio di varie forme di farmaco solido nei siti di produzione di Kaiseraugst e Basilea. Questi includono compresse di film, capsule e granuli per la produzione di sospensioni orali.

La possibilità

Nella Manufacturing Unit Solids DP, offriamo uno stage nel Technical Asset Care Group (workshop), che si rivolge principalmente agli studenti dei settori della tecnologia farmaceutica, ingegneria meccanica, scienze della vita o ingegneria. Durante lo stage, supporterete l'Unità Tecnica presso lo stabilimento di produzione Kaiseraugst. Imparerai a gestire e implementare le ampie normative GMP dell'industria farmaceutica.

In questa posizione:

• Lavoro indipendente su progetti più piccoli (problemi tecnici e procedurali).

• Stabilire e rivedere le procedure operative standard nell'area di manutenzione, risoluzione dei problemi.

• Supporta l'ottimizzazione di diversi processi.

• Lavorare con SAP per ricreare, regolare ed eliminare i piani di manutenzione e le liste delle attività.

• Chiarire le domande sulla manutenzione di vari impianti.

• Sostenere il team nei cambiamenti e nelle misure (azioni correttive) e nelle attività di routine.

• Sii la persona di contatto per diverse interfacce e persone di contatto.

Chi sei

Le seguenti competenze completano il tuo profilo:

• Sei attualmente iscritto a un'università o università di scienze applicate, o hai completato la laurea entro 12 mesi prima dell'inizio dello stage, nel campo dell'ingegneria farmaceutica, ingegneria meccanica, scienze della vita, ingegneria, gestione farmaceutica e produzione o direzioni correlate.

• Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco e buona conoscenza dell'inglese.

• Un alto grado di iniziativa e metodi di lavoro indipendenti e una comprensione rapida.

• Interessato alla cooperazione costruttiva con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni e al lavoro in un team dinamico.

• Buone capacità di comunicazione e capacità di presentazione.

• Buona conoscenza IT nelle applicazioni di ufficio.

Ulteriori informazioni

• La durata dello stage è di 6 - 12 mesi e si svolge nella località Kaiseraugst.

• Si prega di indicare chiaramente nella lettera motivazione la data di inizio desiderata e la durata dello stage. Le domande devono includere un CV e una lettera di motivazione, entrambe riassunte in un documento, così come una panoramica delle prestazioni aggiornate.

• Si prega di indicare chiaramente nella lettera di motivazione o CV in cui data hai completato l'università, se questo è già accaduto.

• A causa di regolamenti, i cittadini al di fuori dell'UE/EFTA devono dimostrare con un documento della loro università che è uno stage obbligatorio, specificare la sua lunghezza esatta e presentare un certificato di iscrizione.

• Questo tirocinio non è adatto per una tesi di laurea o master.

Pronti per il prossimo passo? Siamo lieti

Roche Kaiseraugst is a cornerstone of Roche’s global production and logistics network. Over 1900 people are employed here. The site is home to Roche’s largest and most innovative packaging operations worldwide. Through independent cooperation in diverse teams, we pursue our vision: the best possible patient care at low cost for society!

In the Solids DP manufacturing unit, we take care of the production and packaging of various solid drug forms at the production sites in Kaiseraugst and Basel. These include film tablets, capsules and granules for the production of oral suspensions.

The possibility

In the Manufacturing Unit Solids DP, we offer an internship in the Technical Asset Care Group (workshop), which is primarily aimed at students from the fields of pharmaceutical technology, mechanical engineering, life sciences or engineering. During the internship, you will support the Technical Unit at the Kaiseraugst production plant. You will learn how to handle and implement the extensive GMP regulations of the pharmaceutical industry.

In this position, you will:

• Independently work on smaller projects (technical and procedural issues).

• Establish and revise the standard operating procedures in the area of maintenance, troubleshooting.

• Support the optimization of different processes.

• Working with SAP to recreate, adjust and delete maintenance plans and task lists.

• Clarify questions about the maintenance of various plants.

• Support the team in changes and measures (corrective actions) as well as in routine activities.

• Be the contact person for various interfaces and contact persons.

Who you are

The following competencies round off your profile:

• You are currently enrolled at a university or university of applied sciences, or you have completed your degree within 12 months before the start of the internship, in the field of pharmaceutical engineering, mechanical engineering, life sciences, engineering, pharmaceutical management & production or related directions.

• Very good knowledge of German and good knowledge of English.

• A high degree of initiative and independent working methods as well as fast comprehension.

• Interested in constructive cooperation with internal and external stakeholders as well as working in a dynamic team.

• Good communication skills and presentation skills.

• Good IT knowledge in office applications.

Additional information

• The duration of the internship is 6 - 12 months and takes place at the Kaiseraugst location.

• Please clearly indicate in your motivation letter the desired start date and the duration of the internship. Applications must include a CV and a letter of motivation, both of which are summarized in one document, as well as an up-to-date performance overview.

• Please state clearly in your motivation letter or CV on which date you completed the university, if this has already happened.

• Due to regulations, citizens outside the EU/EFTA have to prove with a document from their university that it is a mandatory internship, specify its exact length and present a certificate of enrollment.

• This internship is not suitable for a bachelor's or master's thesis.

Ready for the next step? We are delighted

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
AI Biology & Translation (AIBT) develops and applies state-of-the-art artificial intelligence to accelerate biomedical discovery across Research and Early Development in Genentech & Roche. We combine advances in foundation models, multimodal machine learning, and large-scale biological data to advance target discovery, disease understanding, biomarker development, and translational science.

We are seeking a (Senior) ML Scientist with deep expertise in modern machine learning to lead the development and application of next-generation AI technologies for designing DNA and RNA sequences for nucleic acid-based medicines. We work closely with stakeholders in Cell Therapy, Gene Therapy, and Vaccine Oncology on diverse projects, ranging from platform development for lab-in-the-loop refinement of sequence designs to lead optimization for portfolio projects. Representative work includes designing regulatory elements to confer cell-type-specific transcription and engineering synonymous coding sequences to enhance translational efficiency.

As a Scientist / Senior Scientist, you will directly lead sequence design campaigns, translating biological questions into predictive and generative models, and driving iterative sequence optimization in close collaboration with wet-lab experimentalists.

The Opportunity

• Build, train, and fine-tune machine learning algorithms to optimize nucleic acid-based medicines for active portfolio projects

• Design candidate sequence libraries for lab-in-the-loop optimization cycles, analyze experimental readouts (e.g., MPRA, NGS), and iteratively update designs

• Collaborate cross-functionally with wet-lab scientists and project leads to understand therapeutic constraints and tailor design algorithms accordingly

• Present technical findings, candidate designs, and model performance metrics to cross-functional team members and stakeholders

• Stay current with advancements in biological sequence modeling and nucleic acid therapeutics to bring state-of-the-art methods into our pipeline

• Contribute to scientific publications

Who You Are

• Ph.D. in a quantitative discipline (Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Machine learning, or a related field) with 0-4 years of post-doctoral or industry experience

• Demonstrated research impact at the interface of machine learning and molecular biology, evidenced by publications in top-tier journals or ML conferences

• Strong Python programming skills and proficiency in deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch

• Hands-on experience developing, training, or fine-tuning sequence-to-function models for biological molecules (preferably DNA/RNA)

• Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to speak to both computational and experimental scientists

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience applying machine learning in a biotech, pharma, or industry setting

• Domain knowledge in nucleic acid-based therapeutics (e.g., mRNA design, AAV capsid/promoter engineering, cell therapy vectors)

• Experience with advanced ML frameworks relevant to sequence design, such as generative modeling (diffusion, autoregressive sequence models, masked language models), active learning, model interpretability, or uncertainty quantification

• Familiarity with high-throughput functional genomics data processing (e.g., MPRA, RNA-seq, ribosome profiling)

About AI Biology & Translation (AIBT)

AI Biology & Translation (AIBT) is part of the Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS-CoE). AIBT advances the development and application of cutting-edge artificial intelligence to accelerate biomedical discovery and translational science. By integrating expertise in machine learning, computational biology, and software engineering, AIBT develops AI capabilities that enable researchers to generate new biological insights, accelerate scientific decision-making, and transform research across Genentech & Roche.

• Familiarità con elaborazione dati genomica funzionale ad alto rendimento (ad esempio, MPRA, RNA-seq, profiling ribosome)

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
AI Biology & Translation (AIBT) develops and applies state-of-the-art artificial intelligence to accelerate biomedical discovery across Research and Early Development in Genentech & Roche. We combine advances in foundation models, multimodal machine learning, and large-scale biological data to advance target discovery, disease understanding, biomarker development, and translational science.

We are seeking a (Senior) ML Scientist with deep expertise in modern machine learning to lead the development and application of next-generation AI technologies for designing DNA and RNA sequences for nucleic acid-based medicines. We work closely with stakeholders in Cell Therapy, Gene Therapy, and Vaccine Oncology on diverse projects, ranging from platform development for lab-in-the-loop refinement of sequence designs to lead optimization for portfolio projects. Representative work includes designing regulatory elements to confer cell-type-specific transcription and engineering synonymous coding sequences to enhance translational efficiency.

As a Scientist / Senior Scientist, you will directly lead sequence design campaigns, translating biological questions into predictive and generative models, and driving iterative sequence optimization in close collaboration with wet-lab experimentalists.

The Opportunity

• Build, train, and fine-tune machine learning algorithms to optimize nucleic acid-based medicines for active portfolio projects

• Design candidate sequence libraries for lab-in-the-loop optimization cycles, analyze experimental readouts (e.g., MPRA, NGS), and iteratively update designs

• Collaborate cross-functionally with wet-lab scientists and project leads to understand therapeutic constraints and tailor design algorithms accordingly

• Present technical findings, candidate designs, and model performance metrics to cross-functional team members and stakeholders

• Stay current with advancements in biological sequence modeling and nucleic acid therapeutics to bring state-of-the-art methods into our pipeline

• Contribute to scientific publications

Who You Are

• Ph.D. in a quantitative discipline (Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Machine learning, or a related field) with 0-4 years of post-doctoral or industry experience

• Demonstrated research impact at the interface of machine learning and molecular biology, evidenced by publications in top-tier journals or ML conferences

• Strong Python programming skills and proficiency in deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch

• Hands-on experience developing, training, or fine-tuning sequence-to-function models for biological molecules (preferably DNA/RNA)

• Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to speak to both computational and experimental scientists

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience applying machine learning in a biotech, pharma, or industry setting

• Domain knowledge in nucleic acid-based therapeutics (e.g., mRNA design, AAV capsid/promoter engineering, cell therapy vectors)

• Experience with advanced ML frameworks relevant to sequence design, such as generative modeling (diffusion, autoregressive sequence models, masked language models), active learning, model interpretability, or uncertainty quantification

• Familiarity with high-throughput functional genomics data processing (e.g., MPRA, RNA-seq, ribosome profiling)

About AI Biology & Translation (AIBT)

AI Biology & Translation (AIBT) is part of the Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS-CoE). AIBT advances the development and application of cutting-edge artificial intelligence to accelerate biomedical discovery and translational science. By integrating expertise in machine learning, computational biology, and software engineering, AIBT develops AI capabilities that enable researchers to generate new biological insights, accelerate scientific decision-making, and transform research across Genentech & Roche.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

You are looking for classic supervisors in vain.

The possibility
As an engineer in heating, ventilation, air conditioning (HLK), you work in the field of “Energies & Utilities” and mainly in the “Site Infrastructure Engineering” district at the Basel/Kaiseraugst site.
Your area of responsibility includes the following exciting activities:

• Self-responsible handling of HVAC projects as project manager, in compliance with the specifications in terms of costs, deadlines, quality and safety.

• Responsibility in investment projects with pronounced complexity and development of innovative and economical solutions for HVAC, also in the GMP environment.

• Creation of targeted specifications and commissioning and coordination of qualified specialist planners, service providers and suppliers taking into account various processing models (e.g. GP, individual awards).

• Supervision of HVAC plants in laboratory, infrastructure and administration buildings as well as in the field of chemical and galenical research, development and production.

• Maintenance of project and work documentation including electronic storage (Comos system).

• Development of ventilation concepts and their optimization.

• Support for official inspections.

Furthermore, you are responsible for shaping your personal and professional development. You are actively involved and take care of the participation in self-organizing teams in the interest of the OneRoche thought. Setting up and expanding a customer network is also one of your responsibilities.

Who you are
Do you value working in a performance-oriented and agile environment that is driven by mutual respect, discussion and collaboration? Then Roche is for you the starting point for an international working environment with a wide range of development opportunities. You are a positive thinking, integrity and self-reflective personality with good communication skills and you have pleasure and skill in dealing with others.

You bring a degree as a building engineering engineer in the field of HVAC, or a comparable education. You have several years of working practice in a relevant function in the field of HVAC. You have already gained practical experience in the GMP environment and are familiar with common rules such as Annex 1 or Guidance for Industry.

As a successful engineer/in HLK bringst You also have the following:

• Self-responsible team- and customer-oriented working method

• Strong leadership characteristics in the project environment

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new computational sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst organisation drives the modernisation of our computational and data ecosystems and integration of digital technologies across Research and Early Development to enable our stakeholders, power data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

The Opportunity

The Data Connectivity Lead for the Fair by Design team is a visionary leader who provides strategic leadership to the Data Capability, has outstanding collaboration capabilities, and can influence without authority. You will be part of the Data Capability leadership team and lead a world-class team of data modelers, architects and governance experts focusing on accelerating the use and access to FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable) and compliant data.

This role involves team management, and close collaboration within the Data & Digital Catalyst department as well as with stakeholders across pRED and gRED to accelerate delivery of seamless access to FAIR and trustworthy data pan-RED.

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the RED’s data landscape, leverage data as a strategic asset and accelerate drug portfolio decision making.

As Data Connectivity Lead, you will develop and implement the data FAIRification and compliance strategy, ensure adoption of data governance and policies and guide a team of experienced experts to guarantee effective management of RED’s data assets. You will make key decisions on talent, resourcing, strategic prioritization, technical roadmaps, business processes and solution development contributing to CS CoE overall success.

• Provide visionary leadership for Data Connectivity within the Data capability while serving as a key member of the Data capability Leadership Team.

• Develop and execute a forward-looking strategy for leveraging AI, automation and advanced technologies to revolutionize data enrichment processes.

• Be responsible for hiring, developing, and retaining talent, fostering opportunities for team members to enhance their skills and impact.

• Define objectives, priorities, Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) for the team

• Drive the modernization and harmonization of workflows and processes to guarantee the delivery of FAIR and Compliant by design AI-ready data assets.

• Oversee large-scale strategic initiatives and data insight development projects, facilitating effective data lifecycle management

• Collaborate with the DDC Domains and capabilities leads as well as with other key stakeholders to align on strategic priorities and support Pharma’s ambition

• Foster strong internal and external partnerships and build a culture of 'data as an asset' in Research and Development.

Who You Are

• You hold a Master’s degree in a scientific or technical field and bring 8+ years of experience in Pharma, Diagnostics or a related R&D data environment, with strong understanding of R&D processes.

• You have hands-on expertise in at least one core data domain, such as data stewardship, data standards, data architecture, FAIRification, data modeling, data quality, metadata or data management.

• You have proven experience leading complex projects, initiatives or teams across multiple stakeholders, with the ability to influence without authority and deliver strong outcomes in a matrix environment. Experience as a group/team leader is a plus.

• You are familiar with regulatory requirements and industry standards related to data privacy, security, quality and compliance.

• Experience with semantic technologies, RDF vocabularies, biomedical ontologies, data standards and data modeling, JSON, SPARQL, federated search, relational databases, knowledge graph technologies, or AWS Neptune would be a strong advantage.

Are you ready to make a difference for our patients? We are looking forward to your application – join us now and become part of our journey!

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Basel. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

La posizione
Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Ecco cosa ci rende Roche.

I progressi in AI, dati e scienze computazionali stanno trasformando la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Le organizzazioni di ricerca e sviluppo precoce di Roche a Genentech (gRED) e Pharma (pRED) hanno dimostrato come queste tecnologie accelerano la R&D, sfruttando i dati e i nuovi modelli computazionali per guidare l'impatto. La condivisione e l'accesso dei dati senza cuciture ai modelli in GRED e pRED sono essenziali per massimizzare queste opportunità. Il nuovo Centro di Eccellenza computazionale (CoE) è un gruppo strategico e unificato il cui obiettivo è quello di sfruttare questo potere trasformativo dei dati e dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) per aiutare i nostri scienziati sia in pRED che in GRED a fornire farmaci più innovativi e trasformativi per i pazienti in tutto il mondo.

All'interno dell'organizzazione CoE, l'organizzazione Data and Digital Catalyst guida la modernizzazione dei nostri ecosistemi di calcolo e dati e l'integrazione delle tecnologie digitali attraverso la ricerca e lo sviluppo precoce per consentire ai nostri stakeholder, la scienza basata sui dati di potenza e l'accelerazione del processo decisionale.

L'opportunità

Il Leader per la Connettività dei Dati per la Fiera di Design è un leader visionario che fornisce una leadership strategica per la Capacità dei Dati, ha eccezionali capacità di collaborazione e può influenzare senza autorità. Sarai parte del team di leadership Data Capability e guiderai un team di modellisti di dati di livello mondiale, architetti e esperti di governance che si concentrano sull'accelerazione dell'utilizzo e dell'accesso a FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable e Reusable) e dati conformi.

Questo ruolo coinvolge la gestione del team, e la stretta collaborazione all'interno del dipartimento Data & Digital Catalyst e con gli stakeholder attraverso pRED e gRED per accelerare la consegna di un accesso senza soluzione di continuità a FAIR e dati affidabili pan-RED.

Questo ruolo offre un’opportunità unica per modellare il panorama dei dati del RED, sfruttare i dati come risorsa strategica e accelerare il processo decisionale del portafoglio di droga.

In qualità di Lead Data Connectivity, svilupperai e implementerai la strategia di FAIRification e compliance dei dati, garantirai l’adozione della governance dei dati e delle politiche e guiderai un team di esperti esperti per garantire una gestione efficace dei dati di RED. Prenderai decisioni chiave sul talento, il risourcing, la priorità strategica, le roadmap tecniche, i processi aziendali e lo sviluppo di soluzioni che contribuiscono al successo complessivo di CS CoE.

• Fornire leadership visionaria per la connettività dei dati all'interno della capacità dei dati, mentre serve come membro chiave del Team di Leadership delle capacità di dati.

• Sviluppare ed eseguire una strategia previsionale per sfruttare AI, automazione e tecnologie avanzate per rivoluzionare i processi di arricchimento dei dati.

• Sii responsabile dell'assunzione, dello sviluppo e del mantenimento di talenti, promuovendo opportunità per i membri del team di migliorare le loro competenze e impatto.

• Definire obiettivi, priorità, obiettivi e risultati chiave (OKRs) per il team

• Guidare l'ammodernamento e l'armonizzazione dei flussi di lavoro e dei processi per garantire la consegna di FAIR e Compliant da parte della progettazione di risorse dati AI-ready.

• Superare iniziative strategiche su larga scala e progetti di sviluppo di informazioni, facilitando una gestione efficace del ciclo di vita dei dati

• Collaborare con i domini e le capacità del DDC porta così come con altri stakeholder chiave per allinearsi alle priorità strategiche e sostenere l’ambizione di Pharma

• Promuovere forti partenariati interni ed esterni e costruire una cultura dei "dati come risorsa" in Ricerca e Sviluppo.

Chi sei

• Hai una laurea magistrale in un campo scientifico o tecnico e porti 8+ anni di esperienza in Pharma, Diagnostics o in un relativo ambiente di dati R&D, con una forte comprensione dei processi R&D.

• Hai esperienza pratica in almeno un dominio di dati core, come la gestione dei dati, gli standard di dati, l'architettura dei dati, la FAIRification, la modellazione dei dati, la qualità dei dati, i metadati o la gestione dei dati.

• Hai dimostrato esperienza che conduce progetti complessi, iniziative o team di diversi stakeholder, con la capacità di influenzare senza autorità e fornire risultati forti in un ambiente matrice. L'esperienza come leader di gruppo / team è un vantaggio.

• Conosci i requisiti normativi e gli standard del settore relativi alla privacy dei dati, alla sicurezza, alla qualità e alla conformità.

• Esperienza con tecnologie semantiche, vocabulries RDF, tologie biomediche, standard di dati e modellazione dei dati, JSON, SPARQL, ricerca federata, database relazionali, tecnologie di grafici di conoscenza, o AWS Neptune sarebbe un vantaggio forte.

Sei pronto a fare la differenza per i nostri pazienti? Non vediamo l'ora della tua applicazione – unisciti a noi ora e diventi parte del nostro viaggio!

Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Basilea. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione.

I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new computational sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst organisation drives the modernisation of our computational and data ecosystems and integration of digital technologies across Research and Early Development to enable our stakeholders, power data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

The Opportunity

The Data Connectivity Lead for the Fair by Design team is a visionary leader who provides strategic leadership to the Data Capability, has outstanding collaboration capabilities, and can influence without authority. You will be part of the Data Capability leadership team and lead a world-class team of data modelers, architects and governance experts focusing on accelerating the use and access to FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable) and compliant data.

This role involves team management, and close collaboration within the Data & Digital Catalyst department as well as with stakeholders across pRED and gRED to accelerate delivery of seamless access to FAIR and trustworthy data pan-RED.

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the RED’s data landscape, leverage data as a strategic asset and accelerate drug portfolio decision making.

As Data Connectivity Lead, you will develop and implement the data FAIRification and compliance strategy, ensure adoption of data governance and policies and guide a team of experienced experts to guarantee effective management of RED’s data assets. You will make key decisions on talent, resourcing, strategic prioritization, technical roadmaps, business processes and solution development contributing to CS CoE overall success.

• Provide visionary leadership for Data Connectivity within the Data capability while serving as a key member of the Data capability Leadership Team.

• Develop and execute a forward-looking strategy for leveraging AI, automation and advanced technologies to revolutionize data enrichment processes.

• Be responsible for hiring, developing, and retaining talent, fostering opportunities for team members to enhance their skills and impact.

• Define objectives, priorities, Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) for the team

• Drive the modernization and harmonization of workflows and processes to guarantee the delivery of FAIR and Compliant by design AI-ready data assets.

• Oversee large-scale strategic initiatives and data insight development projects, facilitating effective data lifecycle management

• Collaborate with the DDC Domains and capabilities leads as well as with other key stakeholders to align on strategic priorities and support Pharma’s ambition

• Foster strong internal and external partnerships and build a culture of 'data as an asset' in Research and Development.

Who You Are

• You hold a Master’s degree in a scientific or technical field and bring 8+ years of experience in Pharma, Diagnostics or a related R&D data environment, with strong understanding of R&D processes.

• You have hands-on expertise in at least one core data domain, such as data stewardship, data standards, data architecture, FAIRification, data modeling, data quality, metadata or data management.

• You have proven experience leading complex projects, initiatives or teams across multiple stakeholders, with the ability to influence without authority and deliver strong outcomes in a matrix environment. Experience as a group/team leader is a plus.

• You are familiar with regulatory requirements and industry standards related to data privacy, security, quality and compliance.

• Experience with semantic technologies, RDF vocabularies, biomedical ontologies, data standards and data modeling, JSON, SPARQL, federated search, relational databases, knowledge graph technologies, or AWS Neptune would be a strong advantage.

Are you ready to make a difference for our patients? We are looking forward to your application – join us now and become part of our journey!

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Basel. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Eine gesündere Zukunft. Es ist das, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche.

Fortschritte in den Bereichen KI, Daten und Computerwissenschaften verändern die Wirkstoffforschung und -entwicklung. Roches Forschungs- und Frühentwicklungsorganisationen bei Genentech (gRED) und Pharma (pRED) haben gezeigt, wie diese Technologien Forschung und Entwicklung beschleunigen, indem sie Daten und neuartige Computermodelle nutzen, um die Auswirkungen zu steigern. Der nahtlose Datenaustausch und der Zugang zu Modellen über gRED und pRED hinweg sind unerlässlich, um diese Möglichkeiten zu maximieren. Das neue Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) ist eine strategische, einheitliche Gruppe, deren Ziel es ist, diese transformative Kraft von Daten und künstlicher Intelligenz (KI) zu nutzen, um unsere Wissenschaftler sowohl in pRED als auch in gRED dabei zu unterstützen, innovativere und transformativere Medikamente für Patienten weltweit zu liefern.

Innerhalb der CoE-Organisation treibt die Data and Digital Catalyst-Organisation die Modernisierung unserer Computer- und Datenökosysteme und die Integration digitaler Technologien in Forschung und Frühentwicklung voran, um unseren Stakeholdern die Möglichkeit zu geben, datengesteuerte Wissenschaft voranzutreiben und die Entscheidungsfindung zu beschleunigen.

Die Chance

Das Data Connectivity Lead for the Fair by Design-Team ist eine visionäre Führungskraft, die die Datenfähigkeit strategisch leitet, über hervorragende Zusammenarbeitsfähigkeiten verfügt und ohne Autorität Einfluss nehmen kann. Sie werden Teil des Data Capability-Führungsteams und führen ein erstklassiges Team von Datenmodellierern, Architekten und Governance-Experten, das sich auf die Beschleunigung der Nutzung und des Zugriffs auf FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable und Reusable) und konforme Daten konzentriert.

Diese Rolle umfasst das Teammanagement und die enge Zusammenarbeit innerhalb der Data & Digital Catalyst-Abteilung sowie mit Stakeholdern in pRED und gRED, um den nahtlosen Zugriff auf FAIR und vertrauenswürdige Daten pan-RED zu beschleunigen.

Diese Rolle bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, die Datenlandschaft von RED zu gestalten, Daten als strategischen Vermögenswert zu nutzen und die Entscheidungsfindung im Arzneimittelportfolio zu beschleunigen.

Als Data Connectivity Lead entwickeln und implementieren Sie die Daten-FAIRification- und Compliance-Strategie, stellen die Übernahme von Daten-Governance und -Richtlinien sicher und leiten ein Team von erfahrenen Experten, um eine effektive Verwaltung der Datenbestände von RED zu gewährleisten. Sie treffen wichtige Entscheidungen zu Talent, Resourcing, strategischer Priorisierung, technischen Roadmaps, Geschäftsprozessen und Lösungsentwicklung, die zum Gesamterfolg von CS CoE beitragen.

• Führen Sie eine visionäre Führung für Data Connectivity innerhalb der Data-Fähigkeit und sind Sie ein wichtiges Mitglied des Data-Fähigkeits-Führungsteams.

• Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer zukunftsweisenden Strategie zur Nutzung von KI, Automatisierung und fortschrittlichen Technologien zur Revolutionierung von Datenanreicherungsprozessen.

• Seien Sie verantwortlich für die Einstellung, Entwicklung und Bindung von Talenten und fördern Sie Möglichkeiten für Teammitglieder, ihre Fähigkeiten und Auswirkungen zu verbessern.
